content.comment_body: Hello, I'm searching for a library that lets an iOS app connect to a [product_name] device. Does anyone have experience with this?
Hi, which software are you planning to use to communicate with [product_name]? Options like Snap7 or KEPServerEX are available as general-purpose solutions.
Hi [user_name], I want to develop a mobile app to control the device. Snap7 works for Android, but I haven't found an iOS equivalent. KEPServerEX seems too complex for what I need.

You might consider using Odrid HMI, which is an iOS app supporting S7 protocol communication with [product_name] (I've tested it with the FS4 model). There's a free panel designer for Windows to create app screens, which can be emailed to an account accessible on your phone, then sent to the Odrid HMI app. The Odrid HMI FAQ describes the connection settings here: [url]. If you develop your own app, you'll need to implement the S7 protocol yourself.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking libraries that allow iOS applications to communicate with [product_name] hardware. While there are Android solutions, an easy-to-use iOS library is missing. Some third-party apps, such as Odrid HMI, are proposed as alternatives, but these do not meet the initial requirement for a development library.
analysis.user_expectations: User wants a straightforward iOS library for connecting to [product_name], similar in functionality to options available for Android.
